description: Retrieve AI-generated insights for a processed media file — topics, sentiment, keywords, action items, summaries, and more. The media must be in 'processed' state (check with get_media_status first). For a video, data.thumbnail has the thumbnail: url, source (auto or custom), pending while a requested frame is being made, and error if that frame failed.

mediaId.description: Unique identifier of the media file

name: get_media_insights

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: Get Media Insights
